props.description: One identical gift box gets re-wrapped over and over in trendier paper — minimalist, neon, vintage, AI-gradient — each rewrap stamped with a new date. Two hands receive identical boxes: one opens and a plant blooms out, the other opens to find it empty. The contents never changed, only the wrapping and the readiness.
